scientific_queries.note: Lambda sweep to test whether R72's negative was a tuning artefact.

subagent_note: None dispatched: the round tries to rescue its own negative by tuning and reports that no lambda rescues it.

design.scope: joint cell+drug holdout, both_unseen pool, same construction as R72
design.selection: lambda is chosen on the search half only and reported on the eval half

robustness_statement: across five orders of magnitude of regularisation the annotation model never reaches the parameter-free marginal baseline; the search half points the same way (about -5 pp), so the gap is not an evaluation-set accident

inconsistency_disclosed.issue: the marginal baseline scores 6.25% here versus 7.25% in R72 for the same nominal pool
inconsistency_disclosed.cause: different random streams (same seed, different call order) give different splits
inconsistency_disclosed.consequence: absolute hit rates are not comparable across rounds; only within-round paired comparisons are trustworthy

limits: lambda is selected on the search half, never on eval
pool sizes and splits drift between rounds
retrospective; no mechanism, clinical or drug-choice claim; no meta-learning or RSI
next_gates: the only remaining rescue would be finer features (pathway, target, expression), which are not available locally

register_updates.C47: new: the negative is independent of regularisation strength
